newsitem.title: CUBA: One dead, six missing in Cuban tanker sinking.
newsitem.headline: One dead, six missing in Cuban tanker sinking.

text.p: At least one sailor died and six were missing when an oil tanker sank off Cuba's north coast after explosions and a fire on board, witnesses and Cuban authorities said on Tuesday.

The tanker Pampero went down on Monday five nautical miles north of Guanabo, a beach resort about 15 miles (25 km) east of Havana, the official Cuban news agency AIN reported. It said the tanker, used for coastal operations around Cuba, was on its way from the port of Matanzas to Havana's Nico Lopez oil refinery where it was due to take on cargo.

The official agency did not say why the tanker sank, apparently in calm seas, or whether it was carrying any oil. Guanabo forms part of Havana's eastern beaches resort area, popular with foreign tourists.
But local inhabitants told reporters they heard more than one explosion and said the vessel caught fire before sinking.

AIN said at least one body was recovered. Six of the tanker's crew were reported missing, three of them Cuban deck officers. Cuban naval, coast guard and tourist craft rescued 18 other crew members, some of them injured.
